# Company OS

Company OS is an agentic chief of staff for teams that lose commitments in meetings and chat. It captures owned commitments, checks in via Chat or each person's messaging channel, escalates blockers with context and gives project leads operational reports (not people scorecards).

## Product
- [/](https://os.jabali.studio/): Homepage and product story
- [/signup](https://os.jabali.studio/signup): Create a workspace
- [/login](https://os.jabali.studio/login): Sign in

## How it works
- [/\#how](https://os.jabali.studio/#how): Six-beat loop (detect, track, check, nudge, escalate, report)
- [/\#teams](https://os.jabali.studio/#teams): Coordination modes for how companies move work
- [/\#reports](https://os.jabali.studio/#reports): Who it serves (project managers, operators, people doing the work)
- [/\#product](https://os.jabali.studio/#product): Commitments, check-ins and escalations
